description: Extract main text, titles, metadata and links from 1–3 public HTTPS pages into one deduplicated, attributed result. No JavaScript rendering, private pages or web search. Up to 6,000 text characters per page; partial source coverage is explicit. Price: 0.012 USDC on Base. Uses x402 v2 HTTP payment headers: retry identical arguments and idempotency key with Payment-Signature and X-XGuard-Quote; the authorization is for the canonical HTTP API resource. No source is fetched before payment.

max_amount_atomic.description: Explicit spending cap in 6-decimal USDC atomic units.

name: xguard.extract
